details:
INTRODUCTION:

We have encountered this issue with the VRC group and its role system on the website and in game. Our community members struggle to self-assign roles. We would like to utilize the roles for the group instances hosted by our community staff. For an example; one of the group instances is meant to be for people with the "Cheese" role only. People without the role should not be able to access the instance (unless via an unlocked link).  In order to see the instance, people must self-assign the "Cheese" role to themselves. This way, users can use roles to filter out events they're not interested in. The current role system is unclear and is not straightforward for us to understand and use. Additionally, the list of roles is hidden within the "Members" menu tab, causing a lot of people to overlook and not find the roles.

PROPOSAL:

We think the VRC group page (both website and in-game) should have a "role" tab so people can easily discover it. There they can view, manage, and self-assign roles. Users with the right privileges can write a short description that explains each role. For example; the "cheese" role's description says "this role is for cool people who like to meet up and discuss cheese." Then it would be much easier for people to understand that it's for events about cheese.

We would also like Group instance invite links to have the "Unlocked" option like Friend instances do, where Unlocked also ignores the role restriction. This is because we're a large community with distinct sub-groups. We post invites for sub-groups in our Discord, so it would be nice to allow users with roles to see the instances in-game specific to their sub-group role, but also allows curious members to join directly via an unlocked link.

CONCLUSION:

Please address this issue as soon as possible. We believe removing the friction self-assigning roles and supporting unlocked links for Group instances would make our events more popular and help the community grow.
title: VRC group's role system improvement
